scope.summary: COLOUR MIXER PARAMETER CONTRACT.** The colour mixer is **eight fixed hue bands** — red, orange, yellow, green, aqua, blue, purple, magenta — each with three adjustments (hue, saturation, luminance), giving 24 parameters, plus an eight-band grayscale mix used when the image is converted to monochrome, plus a point-colour list.
